deadline.value: Non-Canadian applicants apply by April 1, 2027 for September entry, or by March 1 if your visa may take long (likely from India).
deadline.quote: Non-Canadian Applicants - For September start: April 1; if visa processing is likely to be lengthy, please apply by March 1.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission depends on securing a supervisor and funding; contact faculty before you apply.
supervisor.quote: Enrolment in our graduate program depends both on (1) securing a research supervisor and financial support and (2) meeting our standards for academic acceptability. | NOTE: this early contact with faculty should be made before formally applying to our program.

funding.value: All graduate students receive financial support, from scholarships or from stipends paid out of faculty research funds.
funding.quote: Therefore, all of our graduate students receive financial support. | This support typically comes from competitive scholarships awarded to the student or from graduate stipends derived from faculty research funds.

entry_route.value: The PhD requires a thesis-based master's degree or equivalent.
entry_route.quote: For the PhD in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, you'll need: | a thesis-based Master's degree or its equivalent

gre_general.quote: A Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) score is not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 (higher than the FGS minimum).
toefl_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of at least 600 (paper-based) or 100 (internet), or an IELTS score of at least 7.5, is necessary if your native language is not English.

ielts_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of at least 600 (paper-based) or 100 (internet), or an IELTS score of at least 7.5, is necessary if your native language is not English.

english_waiver.value: Waivable if your degree was taught in English and English is an official language of your home country (true for India), subject to FGS verification.
english_waiver.quote: The TOEFL/IELTS requirement may be waived if your degree was earned at an institution where English is the language of instruction, plus English is one of the official languages of your home country.

notes: Minimum admission GPA 3.3. Dalhousie also runs separate PhDs in Microbiology & Immunology, Pharmacology, Pathology, Physiology & Biophysics and Medical Research.
